tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sdom gsum kha skong gi rnam bshad legs par bshad pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpyod ldan blo gsal dag gi rnam dpyod kyi bsti
༄༅/ /sdom gsum kha skong gi rnam bshad legs par bshad pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpyod ldan blo gsal dag gi rnam dpyod kyi bsti

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sdom gsum kha skong gi rnam bshad legs par bshad pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpyod ldan blo gsal dag gi rnam dpyod kyi bsti gnas mdzod cig/ rab dkar byams pa'i lhag bsam 'od kyi rtsen/ /rab zab blo gros dkyil 'khor cha shas rdzogs/ /rab mang rnam bkra gdul bya'i ku mud gnyen/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin bla ma rgyal/ /mes po gos ser mig gsum la sogs pa'i/ /yan lag mchog gi ku mud zum byed cing / /blo ldan bse ru gsung skyes rnam dpyod kyi/ /pad tshal bzhad mdzad thub dbang nyin byed rgyal/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i snying po bdud brtsi'i bcud/ /lugs gnyis ut+pal ku mud ze'u 'bru las/ /gang gi mkhyen brtse nyi zla'i 'od brgya yis/ /bskrun mdzad rgyal tshab byams pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /so gnyis gnas kyi nye dbang sems dpas bskor/ /bdag med dbang mor zhal sbyor bde bas brgyan/ /bskyed rdzogs gdams pa'i spyan stong rnam par bkra/ /tshig mda'i dbang po rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal/ /byang phyogs gangs ri'i spo la gnas kyang 'phags yul gsum rtsen mkhas pa'i rgyan/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i 'gro tshogs skyong yang phas rgol me tog mda' can bsregs/ /zab don u ma'i dpal la rol yang 'chad rtsod gaṅgā'i rgyun la gnas/ /sa skya'i dbang phyug kun gyis bsngags kyang kho bo'i skyabs gcig paṇa chen rgyal/ /mdo rgyud nags ri'i sman ljongs rgyu yang dpal ldan sa skya'i gangs ris spor/ /ngur smrig gos gyis lhab lhub g.yo yang rnam dpyod ral pa'i khur gyis brjid/ /lung rigs nga ros rgol mang 'joms kyang byams pa'i spyan zur kun la g.yo/ /bsod nams seng chen lus stobs ldan yang mkhyen pa'i 'dab rdzogs go ram rgyal/ /bstan pa'i dag byed sdom gsum chu gter che/ /kha skong rdzogs byed dzā hu'i bu mo'i rgyun/ /rab mdzes mdangs gsal nor bu'i phreng ba spel/

/mkhas pa'i 'dun sar mdzes pa'i rgyan du long / /de ltar mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i kha skong gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed 'od kyi snang ba'i rnam bshad nor bu'i phreng ba rtsom par bzhed de/ de yang ji ltar 'chad na/ spyir gzhung 'chad thabs kyi yan lag du ma zhig snang na yang 'dir bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ de la sgra'i bstan bcos las seng ge'i lta stangs kyis khyad par gyi gzhi bslang / sbal pa'i 'phar bas skabs don so sor 'byed/ rus sbal gyi 'gros kyis gzhung don zhib tu 'chad ces 'byung bas gzhung lugs rgya che zhing dka' ba rnams bshad par bya'o/ /zhes gdams pa'i man ngag ltar bshad na gsum ste/ seng ge'i lta stangs kyis khyad gzhi blangs te bsdus don gyi khog phub/ sbal pa'i 'phar bas skabs don so sor phye ste dkyus kyi sa bcad/ ru sbal gyi 'gros kyis gzhung don zhib tu dpyad de tshig gi 'bru gnyer pa'o/ /de ltar gsum po so sor bshad na mang pas 'jigs te/ bsdus don sa bcad dang / tshig 'bru gnyer ba'i zhar la dka' gnas la dogs pa dpyod/ spyi don gyi khog phub pa cung zad re 'byung bas/ 'di gsum phyogs gcig tu snying por dril nas 'chad par byed do/ /de yang thog mar bsdus don gyi sa bcad ni/ bdag nyid chen pos/ don 'dus tshig gsal brjod pa bde/ /ngag nyung tshig snyoms gzung ba sla/ /bsdus don nyid kyis gzhung go ba/ /de 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ brjod bya'i don 'dus pa/ rjod byed kyi tshig gsal ba/ ngag nas brjod bde ba/ ngag gi byed pa nyung ba/ sdeb sbyor gyi tshig snyoms pa/ sa bcad tsam gyis gzhung don gsal ler go nus pa'i man ngag drug dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na 'chad pa pos 'chad sla/ nyan pa pos gzung sla/ gnyis ka'i sna bar snyan pa'i sgo nas brjod bya'i don 'khrul pa med pa zhig rtsom shes na/

rtsom pa po mkhas pa'i grangs su 'gro zhing bstan pa la phan pa yin gyi/ de ltar min na bstan bcos rnam dag chud zos pa dang / gdul bya'i yid la re ba bslu ba byed pas btang snyoms su bag yod par byas na mdzes/ de bas na mkhas pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bstan bcos 'di 'chad pa la gsum/ rtsom la 'jug pa klad kyi don/ brtsam bya gzhung gi don/ brtsams pa mthar phyir 'jug gi don no/ /dang po gsum/ mtshan don/ 'gyur phyag brtsam par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gang bshad par bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i kha skong gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba zhes bya ste/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i 'phro kha skong bar byed pa dang / kha skong ba'i tshul yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum la 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi rnam gzhag phyin ci ma log par gsal bar byed pa'i sgo nas legs bshad kyi 'od kyi snang ba phyogs bcur spros ste/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa chos dbyings su gshegs nas bstan bcos 'di ma brtsam bar gyi chos min gyi mun pa sel bar mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sdom gsum rab dbye de rtsom pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan bcos min par thal/ khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di brtsams te de nyid kyi kha skong dgos pa'i phyir snyam na/ ma khyab ste/ bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbyes/ chos min gyi mun pa bcom pa'i rjes su/ slar yang chos min gyi mun pa cung zad 'thibs pa rnams/ bstan bcos 'di'i 'od snang bas bcom ste/ sngar gyi snang ba'i 'phro mthud pa la kha skong zhes zhu ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'gyur phyag mtshungs pa'i mchod brjod bshad/ brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /yul gang la na/ sdom gsum gter ba'i rtsa rgyud kyi rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams dang /

lhag pa'i lha mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la'o/ /tshul ji ltar na sgo gsum gus pas so/ /'di la 'gyur phyag dang mtshungs pa'i mchod brjod ces bya ste/ lo tsā ba rnams kyi bstan bcos sdud pa'i tshe lhag pa'i lha ji ltar 'os pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gus pas btud do zhes pa bshad pa'i gzhir byas/ su zhig gis she na/ mkhas pa'i dbang po go rab 'byams pa bdag gis so/ /yul gang la na/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi yon tan dbyer med du tshang ba'i bde gshegs snying po de la'o/ /'o na gzhi lam 'bras bu ni gang / de snying po la dbyer med du ji ltar tshang snyam na/ yon tan dang rang bzhin lhun grub tu gzhir gnas pa'i chos dbyings ni gzhi yin la/ de'i steng gi sgrib pa'i dri ma sel bar byed pa'i thabs ni lam yin zhing / sbyangs pas gnas gyur pa'i bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i thob bya ni 'bras bu'o/ /tshang ba'i tshul ni/ snying po la de gsum dbyer med du tshang ste/ gzhi ngo bo'i sgo nas dang / lam sa bon gyi tshul gyis dang / 'bras bu nus mthu'i tshul gyis tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /yang na snying po de gsum dang dbyer med yin pas tshang ba ste/ snying po de gsum las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na snying po de/ gnas skabs de gsum dang dbyer med pas tshang ba ste/ snying po de gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gnas skabs su/ bzang ngan gang du yang 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na/ gnas gyur bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras/ /dbyer med snying po de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes pa mtha'i gsal byed du sbyar te/ de lta bu'i 'bras bu dang dbyer med pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal/ sgrib pa'i dri ma sel bar byed pa'i lam dang dbyer med pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal/ zhes sogs gsum char la sbyar ro/ /tshul ji ltar na sgo gsum gus pas so/ /'di la brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod ces bya ste/

gzhi lam 'bras gsum po de bstan bcos 'di yi brjod bya gang zhig de gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas de gsum dang dbyer med pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ de ltar phyag 'tshal nas ci byed na/ bstan bcos 'di brtsam par byed ces pa ste/ 'di la drug bshad bya gang bshad pa/ rgyu gang la rten nas bshad pa/ yul gang la bshad pa/ kun slong gang gis bshad pa/ dus nam gyi tshe bshad pa/ de ltar bshad pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed 'od kyi snang ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang bzo ma yin par rgyal ba'i bka' dang rgya bod kyi tshad ldan gyi gzhung lugs dang / 'khrul pa zad pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rgyud pa dang bcas pa'i man ngag la brten nas so/ /gsum pa ni/ blo gzu bor gnas pa sogs snod ldan gyi 'dul bya gzhan la'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir du brtse bas kun nas blangs pa'i lhag bsam gyis so/ /lnga pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo gsum stong drug brgya dang dgu 'das pa'i bcu pa dang / bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa chos dbyings gshegs nas lo nyis brgya dang nyer bdun 'das pa'i nyer brgyad pa/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po kun mkhyen chen po lo lnga bcur phebs pa sa pho khyi la chos log sun 'byin gyi bstan bcos 'di brtsams/ drug pa dgos pa ni/ 'di lta bu'i bstan bcos rtsom pa ni/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po'i las su bgyi ba'i gtso bo mchog tu gyur pa yin pas dgos pa chen po bzhi dang ldan te/ rang nyid bstan 'dzin chen por mtshon pa'i dgos pa/ bdag nyid chen po'i zhal gdams bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pas bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dgos pa/ log smra tshar bcad nas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i dgos pa/

bstan pa yun ring du dag par gnas nas 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'idagos pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags dang po grub ste/ bod gangs can du/ ston pa 'das nas lo sum stong brgya pa'i skabs su rin chen bzang pos chos log sun 'byin gyi stan bcos brtsams te bstan 'dzin chen por gyur/ gsum stong nyis brgya pa'i skabs su 'gos lo tsā ba lha btsas kyis sngags log sun 'byin gyi bstan bcos chen po brtsams te bstan 'dzin chen por gyur/ gsum stong sum brgya pa'i skabs su bdag nyid chen pos sdom gsum rab dbyes chos dang chos min rnam par dbye ba las bstan pa dag par gnas pa de bzhin du/ gsum stong drug brgya pa'i skabs su kun mkhyen chen pos bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa las bstan pa dag par gnas pa'i nus pa thob pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ bdag nyid chen pos rab dbye las/ da dung 'khrul pa'i rnam bzhag ni/ /skyon can dpag med snang na yang / /gzhung mang dogs pas re zhig bzhag /gal te lung dang rigs pa'i gnad/ /shes pa'i blo ldan rnams kyis de/ /legs par dpyod la dgag sgrub gyis/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas bstan dang phrad dka' zhing / /dal ba 'byor pa rnyed dka' bas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis legs rtogs la/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i blo yis dpyod/ /ces rab dbyes ma bkag pa'i bstan pa'i gnad bcos pa'i chos log phra rags rnams phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis khog cig ces gdams pa'i snying po/ mkhas rlom gzhan sus kyang spobs par ma nus kyis mkhas pa khyod kyis legs par bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis/ don gsum ngos bzung ste lus kyi rnam bzhag bshad/ lung dang rigs pas dpyad de yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum sbyang gzhi gzhi yi ngos 'dzin bshad/ sbyong byed lam gyi ngos 'dzin bshad/ sbyang 'bras 'bras bu'i ngos 'dzin bshad pa'o/

/dang po ni/ 'o na khyod gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed kyi bstan bcos rtsom pa yin na/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum po de ji lta bu zhe na/ dang po gzhi ngos bzung ba ni/ shel dang chos mtshungs pa'i sems bden pas stong pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug gi dbyings nyid chos can/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi yin te/ 'khor 'das gnyis po de khyod thabs kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i bye brag las 'byung pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na shel dang ji ltar chos mtshungs na/ gnyis snang gi dri ma rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sgo nas 'od gsal ba'i sems chos can/ shel dkar gyi khams dang chos mtshungs te/ rang ngos nas gzung 'dzin gyi sngo ser du ma grub kyang / bag chags kyi tshon sngo ser gyis kha bsgyur pa las/ gnas skabs de dang der gzung 'dzin gyi sngo ser sogs du mar snang ba'i gsal cha yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir shel dang chos mtshungs pa ni/ yul gyis kha ma bsgyur ba'i sems gsal rig nyid yin gyi/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po ni ma yin te/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba zhes pa sems bden pas stong ba'i stong nyid la bshad pa dang / gnyis snang gi dri mas ma gos pa'i sems gsal rig la bshad pa gnyis yod pa las/ skabs 'dir phyi ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bde gshegs snying po/ zung 'jug gi ye shes la 'chad na/ bde gshegs snying po nyid shel dang chos mtshungs su sbyor ba gnad kyi don yin no/ /gnyis pa lam ngos gzung ba ni/ lcags zangs dngul gsum dang rim bzhin chos mtshungs pa'i nyan thos rang rgyal phar phyin theg pa'i bslab pa gsum dang / de gsum rig pa 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i gser bsgyur gyi rtsi yis/ gsang chen gyi bslab pa'i gser du bsgyur ba'i sngags kyi nyams len rnams ni chos can/ lam gyi mchog yin te/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i steng gi nyon mongs gsum gyi dri ma sbyong byed yin pa'i phyir te/

nyan rang gi bslab pas nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma gtso bor sbyong / byang sems kyi bslab pas las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma sbyong / sngags kyi bslab pas skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu ngos gzung ba ni/ gnas gyur dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings kyi nam mkhar/ stobs sogs bral 'bras kyi yon tan so gnyis kyi zla ba shar ba las/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya rang sems dag pa'i chu gtsang du/ rnam smin gyi yon tan mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba 'di yin no/ /'bras bu 'o zhes bya ste/ sbyang gzhi'i steng du sbyong byed lam gyi dri ma sbyangs pa'i thob bya mthar thug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na khyod kyis/ gnas gyur gyi dbyings nam mkha' dang / stobs sogs bral 'bras kyi ye shes nam mkha'i zla ba dang / gzugs sku rnam gnyis chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang dpe don sbyar ba 'di mi 'thad par thal/ rgyud bla ma las/ dag las nye dang ring rnams la/ /'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /chu dang nam mkhar zla gzugs bzhin/ /de mthong ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes nye ba'i gdul bya yid dag pa la rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du longs sku'i snang ba shar ba ni nam mkha'i zla ba dang / ring ba'i gdul bya nyan rang sogs yid dag pa la sprul sku'i snang ba shar ba ni chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi dpe dang sbyar nas bshad 'dug pa'i phyir snyam na/ skyon med de/ gzhung des de ltar bshad pa bden mod kyang / de'i gong der rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar sprin med nam mkha'i zla ba'i gzugs/ /ston kha'i chu sngon mtshor ni mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal sras tshogs kyi khyab bdag gzugs/ /rdzogs sangs dkyil 'khor nang du mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / thub pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis chu zla bzhin/

/zhes gzugs sku gnyis char chu zla'i gzugs brnyan dang dpe don sbyar ba yang yod pas/ phyogs gcig kho na la zhen pa mkhas pa'i rnam thar min pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa yan lag rgyas bshad la/ 'o na khyod gzhi lam 'bras gsum la 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsal ba'i sgo nas/ rab dbye'i kha skong 'di brtsam pa yin na/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma ji ltar byung zhing / de ji ltar sel bar byed snyam na/ 'di la gsum/ gzhi la 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsal/ lam la 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsal/ 'bras bu la 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsal ba'o/ /dang po la'ang gsum/ thun mong rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ so so'i log rtog bye brag dgag gnad kyi snying po bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos smra'i lugs gsum bsdus te bstan/ dbu ma'i lugs gcig rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi la dngos smra ba gsum la'ang grub mtha'i 'dod tshul gyis mi 'dra ba gsum yod de/ bye brag smra bas/ ma chags 'phags rigs de dag las/ /zhes pa ltar chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal ngan ngon gyi chog shes pa dang / spong ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba ste bzhis bsdus pa'i 'dod chung chog shes kyi sems byung la gzhir 'dod pa dang / mod sde pas rgyal po sras las/ mdo sde pa dag gis rigs ni sems kyi sa bon nus pa ste/ so so skye bo dang slob pa'i gnas skabs na yang yongs su ma nyams pa'i chos can gyi sa bon la rigs zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar thos sogs kyi bag chags kyis gsar du bzhag pa'i zag med kyi sa bon la gzhir 'dod pa dang / sems tsam pas byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rigs de ni thog ma med pa nas 'ongs pa chos nyid kyis thob pa skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ zhes pa ltar/ kun gzhi'i steng du gsar du gzhag pa min par chos nyid kyis thob pa'i zag med sa bon gyi cha/ skye mched drug gi khyad par/ thos pa'i bag chags sam/

sgrib pa spong rung zhes sogs ming gi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa zhig la gzhir 'dod pa dang gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir zag med kyi sa bon ni/ sems kyi gsal cha nyid la/ zag med kyi yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu byed pa'i cha nas ming btags pa yin la/ skye mched drug gi khyad par zhes pa ni/ kun gzhi ma bzhag pa'i dbang du byas na/ nang gi skye mched drug tu gtogs pa'i rnam rig gi steng gi gsal cha nyid/ zag med kyi sa bon yin zhes pa'i don yin la/ kun gzhi rnam par bzhag pa na/ kun gzhi'i steng gi gsal cha nyid/ zag med kyi sa bon du khas blangs pas chog pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /de ltar 'dod pa mi 'dra ba gsum yod kyang / dngos smra bas 'dod pa'i gzhi de rnams gzhi mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ de dag 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te dngos smra bas gsum po dag la rigs su 'dod kyang / gzhir mi 'dod/ bye brag smra bas shes bya gzhi lnga la gzhi dang / mdo sde pas rang spyi gnyis la gzhi dang / sems tsam pas mtshan nyid gsum dang khyad par chos dbyings la gzhir 'dod pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ skyon med de/ thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i gzhi ni shes bya gzhi lngasogs la 'dod kyang / sgom pas nyams su blang bya'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gzhi'i gtso bo ni/ rigs la nges par gzung dgos pa yin te/ lam gyis gnad du bsnun te dri ma sbyangs pa las/ 'bras bur gnas 'gyur ba ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gzhi'i gnad kyi snying po yin la/ de nyid rigs la tshang gi gzhan la ma tshang ba'i phyir dang / sems tsam pas kyang / chos dbyings la bde gshegs snying por 'dod kyang / rigs su mi 'dod de/ rigs la 'dus byas dang / bde gshegs snying po la 'dus ma byas kyis khyab par sems tsam pas 'dod pa'i phyir zhes mkhas pa 'dis bshad pa'i phyir/ des na grub mtha' smra ba bzhi char gyi lugs la/ rang rang 'dod pa'i gzhi'i gtso bo de rigs su 'dod pa gnad kyi don no/

/gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs la bzhi/ srol 'byed gnyis kyi bzhed lugs ngo yis gzung / /yon tan ldog pa so sor 'chad pa'i tshul/ /don gyi dgongs pa gcig tu grub pa'i tshul/ /de ltar grub pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems gsal ba rgyun chags ma 'gags pa mtha' bzhi'i spros pas stong pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug gi dbyings 'dus ma byas chos can/ khyod dbu ma'i skabs 'dir byams mgon dang klu sgrub gnyis char gyis gzhir bzhed payin te/ thabs kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i bye brag gi 'khor 'das gnyis ka 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i yul gyi gnas lugs mthar thug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na skabs 'dir gzhi la mtshan nyid zur bzhi ldan te/ gsal ba spangs pa'i stong rkyang dang / stong pa spangs pa'i gsal rkyang ma yin par gsal stong dbyer med kyi zung 'jug yin zhing / zung 'jug gi gsal ba la yang gsal ba rgyun chad ma yin par rgyun mi chad pa dang / stong pa la yang mtha' gcig gnyis tsam bkag pa ma yin par/ mtha' bzhi char bkag pa'i stong pa dgos pas gnad bzhi ldan te/ zur dang pos nyan thos 'gog pa lta bu'i stong rkyang dang / zur gnyis pas rnam rig pa 'dod pa'i bden grub kyi sems gsal rkyang dang / zur gsum pas sgo lnga'i rnam shes tsam dang zung du 'jug pa'i stong pa dang / zur bzhi pas nyan rang 'phags pa'i rtogs bya'i gzhi rnams bcad nas/ theg chen dbu ma lugs kyi gzhi'i gnas lugs dpyis phyin par ngos gzung 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di kun mkhyen nyid kyi dgongs pa ste kho bos rtogs so/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ rgyud blar ji snyed ldog pa bshad pa'i tshul/ rigs tshogs ji lta'i ldog pa bshad pa'i tshul/ bstod tshogs zung 'jug ldog pa bshad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ theg chen dbu ma'i lugs de la yang byams mgon gyis theg chen rgyud bla mar gsal stong zung 'jug gi gsal ba'i ldog pa nas gtso bor bshad de/

gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan gyi ldog pa ma lus par tshang ba'i bde gshegs snying po ni/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /zhes sogs sgrub byed gsum gyis 'gro ba'i rgyud la yod par sgrub/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug pa dang / /zhes sogs rnam bzhag bcus gtan la phab/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /zhes sogs dri mas sgrib tshul dpe dgus bstan/ dag thob bral ba rang gzhan don/ /ces sogs dang / rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /zhes sogs dang / brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /zhes sogs/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi byang chub dang / bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan drug cu rtsa gnyis dang / rgyun mi 'chad pa dang lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las gnyis la sogs pa'i 'bras bu'i gnas tshul khyad par du bshad pa rnams/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas gdod ma nas ma gos pa'i dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ye shes 'di nyid la dgongs nas bshad pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di nyir glo bur gyi dri ma'i sbubs na yod pa'i tshul khams ler sgrub byed gsum dang rnam bzhag bcu dang dpe dgus gtan la phab ste/ byang chub yon tan 'phrin las kyi le'u gsum du de nyid glo bur gyi dri ma las grol nas mngon du gyur pa'i tshul bshad pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar sgrub byed gsum dang rnam bzhag bcu dang dpe dgus gtan la phab pa sogs/ dri mas ma gos pa'i sems gsal ba'i ldog pa nas de dag bshad par ji ltar rung snyam na/ bshad par bya ste/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med/ /ces pa'i dri bcas de bzhin nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe/ thogs med 'grel chen las dpal 'phreng mdo drangs pa na/ lha mo chos 'di gnyis ni rtogs par dka' ba ste sems rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa rtogs par dka' ba dang / sems de'i kun nas nyon mongs pa rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /lha mo chos 'di gnyis nyan par byed pa ni khyod dang yang na chos chen po dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams yin no zhes/

dri mas rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sems gsal rig de nyid dri bcas de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan gzhir bkod pa'i phyir dang / sems de rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na/ nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs pas/ /zhes pa'i 'grel chen las kyang / de la sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa dang / sems de'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa 'di gnyis ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i sems dag la gcig tu rgyu bas sems gnyis pa 'tshams sbyor ba med pa'i tshul gyis zag pa med pa'i dbyings la mchog tu rtogs par dka' ba yin no zhes/ gzhung 'di'i lta ba'i mthar thug sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes pa ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems gsal rig la bshad pa'i phyir dang / khyad par dpe dgu don dgu'i 'thad kyi 'grel chen las/ mdor na snying po'i mdor dper brjod pa bstan pa 'di dag ni sems kyi khams ma lus pa'i thog ma med pa'i sems kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos glo bur ba nyid dang / thog ma med pa'i sems rnam par byang ba'i chos lhan cig skyes pa rnam par dbye ba med pa nyid du bstan to/ /zhes dpe dgus bstan pa'i snying po ni rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems la ngos gzung nas/ de nyid la rnam byang gi sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / zag med kyi sems dang / gnyis med kyi ye shes sogs kyi ming btags nas gtan la phab par shin tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi gzhi yi ngos 'dzin ni/ klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs tshogs las/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi stong pa'i ldog pa nas gtso bor bshad de/ rten 'brel gyi gnad/ chos thams bcad kyi steng du mtha' bzhi spros pa yis stong tshul/ rten 'brel gyi rigs pa yis gtan la phab nas/ chos thams cad bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid la 'khor 'das kun gyi bya byed rung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na rten 'brel gyi gnad ji lta bu/

'di stong pa'i ldog pa nas bshad par ji ltar shes snyam na bshad par bya ste/ rten 'brel gyi chos thams cad bden stong du gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ rten 'brel rtogs pa'i gnad kyi gtso bo dang / grub mtha' bzhi las dbu ma'i grub mtha'i gnad kyi gtso bo yin te/ dngos smra bas ni/ rten 'brel yin na bden grub kyis khyab pa bcas nas/ bden pas stong pa la rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi rung bar khas blangs pas/ rten 'brel gyi gnad dam don gtan nas ma rtogs pa yin la/ dbu ma pas ni/ rten 'brel gyi rtags las chos gcig bden med du rtogs na/ chos thams cad bden med du rang grol du song bas/ rten 'brel gyi gnad dam snying po ches gsal bar rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di nyid spyir dbu ma pa dang / khyad par dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa'i dbyings mthil phyin pa ste/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/ gang dag brten nas dngos po rnams/ /de nyid du ni grub 'dod pa/ /de dag la yang rtags sogs skyon/ /de dag ji ltar 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / rten 'brel la bden grub kyis khyab pa khas blangs pa'i dngos smra ba rnams ni rtag chad kyi mtha' las ma 'das so zhes bshad nas/ gang dag brten nas dngos po rnams/ /chu yi zla ba lta bur ni/ /yang dag ma yin log min par/ /'dod pa de dag ltas mi 'phrogs/ /zhes rten 'byung la bden med kyis khyab pa'i gnad shes pa ni rtag chad kyi mtha' las grol bas dbu ma pa chen po yin no zhes bshad de/ grub don sdud pa na/ dngos por khas len yod na ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mi zad 'byung / /de las byung ba'i rtsod par 'gyur/ /de ni lta ba kun gyi rgyu/ /de med nyon mongs mi skye ste/ /de phyir de ni yongs shes na/ /lta dang nyon mongs yongs su byang / /zhes ji srid bden grub kyi chos cung zad gcig khas len pa de srid du dngos smra ba yin pas dbu ma'i lta ba mi rtogs zhing /

spang bya chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sa bon spong bar mi nus pas chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sa bon spong ba la bden med rtogs dgos so zhes bshad nas/ bden med de gang las rtogs snyam na/ gang gis de shes 'gyur snyam na/ /brten nas 'byung ba mthong bas te/ /brten nas skyes pa ma skyes par/ /de nyid mkhyen pa mchog gis gsungs/ /zhes gang brten nas skyes pa la rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pas khyab pa'i gnad shes pa ni/ rten 'brel gyi gnad rtogs pa dbu ma pa yin pas/ gnad de nyid rtogs na/ chos thams cad bden med du rang grol la rtogs nus kyi/ chos 'ga' zhig bden med du 'dod pa snyam byed kyang / chos phra rags cung zad gcig bden med du ma rtogs na/ rten 'brel gyi gnad ma rtogs pa yin pas chos gang la yang bden med kyi rtogs pa mtshan nyid pa mi skye ste/ chos shes pa yi 'og tu ni/ /'di la bye brag yod na yang / /gang gis skye bar rnam brtags pa/ /rnam par mi mkhas de yis ni/ /rkyen las byung ba'i don ma mthong / /zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di rtogs na 'phags pa yin na dbu ma pa yin pas khyab pa dang / chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pas khyab pa ni/ klu sgrub kyi dgongs par/ rnam dpyod skal bar ldan pa dag gis mi rtogs kha med yin mod/ bdag gi 'dren pa dpal 'bum phrag gsum pas/ nyan rang la rnam grangs pa'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa tsam las med par bshad pa dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'di nyid kyis/ ngar 'dzin skye ba'i gzhi phung po lnga tsam bden med du rtogs kyi de las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad bden med du ma rtogs par bshad pa dang / gzigs pa'i spyan yangs shākya mchog ldan gyis 'dus byas thams cad bden med du rtogs kyang / 'dus ma byas chos nyid bden med du ma rtogs par bshad pa sogs ni/ deng sang gi gdul bya blo nus zhan pa rnams kha drang ba'i ched tsam yin gyis/

rten 'brel gyi gnad zab mo la thugs g.yel ba ga la yin/ ri bo dge ldan pas/ gnad 'di thogs med rjes 'brang gi skabs su yang sbyar nas dgongs pa gcig tu 'chad pa ni/ srol 'byed pa'i dgongs pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa'i gnad ma rtogs pa ste 'og tu 'chad do/ /des na rigs tshogs las gzhi'i ngo bo stong pa'i ldog pa nas bshad de/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /zhes sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gang / /zhes sogs kyis chos thams cad kyi steng du mtha' bzhi'i spros pa bkag pa'i bden stong la bde gshegs snying por bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis bstod pa'i tshogs su gzhi'i ngos 'dzin/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ldog pa nas bshad de/ chos dbyings bstod pa sogs las/ rten 'brel gyi rtags las 'dus byas bden pas stong ba'i stong nyid de'ang bkag bya bden grub bkag pa'i ci yang med pa tsam yin pa spangs nas/ ye nas dri mas ma gos pa'i sems kyi gsal cha rgyun chags dang zung 'jug yin par bshad pa'i phyir te/ gzhi stong pa nyid la 'khor 'das kyi bya byed rung bar gsungs pa ni 'khor 'das rang bzhin gyi lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dang zung du 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir yin gyi/ dgag bya bden pa bcad tsam gyi cha nas ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yin na nam mkha' yang der thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang bstod tshogs las zung 'jug gi ldog pa nas bshad par ji ltar shes snyam na bshas par bya ste/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ sa yi dkyil na yod pa'i chu/ /dri ma med par gnas pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nang na ye shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes nyon mongs pa'i sbubs na gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas ma gos pa'i sems rang gsal la/ ye shes kyi ming btags pa de gnas lugs su bshad nas/ de nyid bden par grub bam snyam pa na/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa las/

gang gi dngos po rten 'byung rnams/ /ngo bo med pa nyid du gsungs/ /zhes rten 'brel gyi rtags las de yang bden med du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ gnad des na theg chen dbu ma yi lugs kyi gzhi'i 'dod tshul la/ rgyal tshab byams pa dang / rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i dbu sems kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed 'di gnyis dgongs pa mthun te/ bka' bar pa'i dgongs pa dang sbyar te dngos bstan stong nyid kyi ldog pa dang / sbas don gsal ba'i ldog pa nas bshad pa'i bshad tshul tha dad kyang / ngo bo zung 'jug la 'jog par bshad zin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung 'di rgyal tshab rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i/ /zhes pa ltar dag pa yin gyi/ rgyal tshab byams pas lung bstan pa'i zhes 'byung ba ni ma dag pa yin te/ byams pas srol 'byed gnyis la lung bstan pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir kun mkhyen nyid kyis srol 'byed gnyis dbu ma'i gzhi ngos 'dzin tshul dgongs pa gcig tu bsgrubs la/ de ltar na 'di gnyis kyi lta ba'i mthar thug rang stong dbu mar bskyal ba yin mod/ mkhas pa rnam dpyod ldan pas rnam par gzhigs na 'di gnyis kyi mthar thug rang stong dang gzhan stong gang yin la dpyad par bya ba'i gzhi mang du yod cing / rang stong yin pa gzhir bzhag tu byas na yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ches gsal ba yod pa ni rim gyis 'chad par bzhed pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //bzhi pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad pa la gnyis/ phar phyin gzhung nas bshad pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad/ sngags kyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni dbu ma lugs kyi gzhi chos can/ khyod mdo nas bshad pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan te/ chos dbyings dang dri bcas de bzhin nyid/ rang bzhin 'od gsal dang bde gshegs snying po dang / sems kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas khyod bstan pa'i phyir dang /

lang gshegs las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po kun gzhi'i rnam par shes par sgrags pa sbyang bar bya'o zhes dang / rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ ji ltar zla ba skar tshogs dang / /mkha' la lhan cig gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang / /rnam shes bdun dang lhan cig gnas/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud ces dang / dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyi 'jug 'grel las/ dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir stong pa nyid kho na la kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i sgras bstan par rig par bya'o/ /zhes sogs kyi kun gzhi'i sgra yang khyod kyi gsal cha dang stong cha 'di la ci ltar rigs par dgongs te bshad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma lugs kyi gzhi gsal stong zung 'jug chos can/ khyod la rgyud nas bshad pa'i mtshan gyi rnam drangs dang ldan te/ zab mo'i rgyud du 'jam dpal du/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /ces 'jam dpal dang / lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes ye shes chen po dang / rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /ces lhan cig skyes pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med/ /bcad dang gzhig par bya ba min/ /bsreg par bya med gzhig med par/ /stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya/ /zhes rdo rje dang / yang brtag gnyis las/ rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod/ /sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa/ /'dis ni shes rab rigs pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpar brjod par bya/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpa' dang / shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /zhes dpal dang / kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /zhes kun bzang dang dpal mchog la sogs kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs bgrang yas kyis bstan pa'i phyir ro/

/'on kyang mdo sngags nas bshad pa'i rnam grangs de dag don gcig tu ni 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /'dir dpyad dgos pa'i dogs pa ni 'di ltar yin te/ rang lugs kyi gzhi'i ngos 'dzin rgyud bla rtsa 'grel las gnyis med kyi ye shes la ngos bzung ba dang / rigs tshogs las rten 'brel gyi rtags las 'dus byas bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid la bshad pa dang / stod tshogs las zung 'jug la bshad pa dang / de dag mdo rgyud nas mtshan gyi rnam grangs tha dad du bshad pa de dag thun mong du 'gal med du khas len nam so sor khas len snyam na/ spyir rgyal ba'i 'khor lo tha ma dang / rgyud bla rtsa 'grel gyi skabs su gzhi bde gshegs snying po'am chos dbyings la/ gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi ming can gyi shes pa gsal rig gi cha kho na yin pas khyab pa dang / de yang theg chen 'phags pa kho nas mngon sum du rtogs kyi/ theg dman 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul gtan nas ma yin par bshad/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa dang / rigs tshogs rtsa 'grel gyi skabs su/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po de nyid/ chos thams cad bden pa bkag pa'i stong nyid kho na yin pas khyab cing / de yang 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du bshad/ de gnyis char gyi skabs su gzhi de nyid/ sgro skur gyi mtha' dang / rtag chad kyi mtha' sogs dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas shig yin dgos par bshad cing / mdo rgyud tshad ldan gzhan rnams las de gnyis ci rigs par bshad pa yin pa la/ de gnyis so so'i skabs su rang rang nas bshad pa ltar so sor khas len gyi phan tshun bsres nas khas mi len yang / 'dir mdo rgyud bstan bcos tshad ldan thams cad kyi legs pa'i cha bsdus nas thun mong du gung bsgrigs nas 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas/ bka' bar tha gnyis dang shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis kyi dgongs pa thun mong du 'gal med du bsgrubs nas 'chad par byed do/

/'o na 'gal med du ji ltar dam bca'/ lung rigs kyis ji ltar sgrub snyam na/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po ni gsal stong zung 'jug yin zhing / de gsum yang ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad yin pas/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi zlas phye ba'i gsal cha stong cha zung 'jug gi cha gsum ka bde gshegs snying po yin pas/ thogs med kyis gsal cha nas bde gshegs snying po ngos bzung yang / de stong nyid du mi bzhed pa ma yin la/ klu sgrub kyis stong cha nas ngos bzung yang de gsal rig tu mi bzhed pa yang ma yin pas don dril na/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po yin na/ shes pa gsal rig yin pas kyang khyab la/ chos nyid 'dus ma byas yin pas kyang khyab bo zhes pa ni/ spyir bka' mdo rgyud dang / khyad par kun mkhyen chen po 'di nyid kyi dgongs par dam bca' 'o/ /'o na dam bca' 'di ji ltar sgrub snyam na/ 'dir skabs kyi bde gshegs snying po 'di/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas gdod ma nas dag pa'i shes pa gsal rig yin par 'chad dgos te/ snying po'i gsal stong zung 'jug gi gsal ba'i cha de bde gshegs snying po yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las snying po gsal ba sems kyi cha la ngos gzung zhing bzung ba ltar 'dir yang khas len rigs pa'i phyir dang / 'di'i skabs kyi snying po 'di/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rgyud man ngag nas bshad pa'i kun gzhi rgyu rgyud yin zhing / de nyid shes pa yin par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rgyud man ngag las bshad pa'i phyir dang / snying po de/ lang gshegs sogs dang dpal ldan zla bas bshad pa'i kun gzhi yin zhing de yang shes pa yin pa'i phyir dang / snying po de rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi ye shes chen po yin zhing de yang shes pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyudaṃ gnyisaṃ ldanaṃ gyiṃ rtags dang po grub ste 'di nyid las/ de yang theg chen rgyud bla las/ /zhes sogs dang /

de nyid la sa bcad kyang rgyud bla las ji snyed pa'i ldog pa nas bshad tshul zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa'i zur dang po ni/ 'di nyid las/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag dang / /zhes sogs bshad pas grub cing / zur gnyis pa kun gzhi rgyu rgyud de nyid shes pa yin par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rgyud man ngag las bshad pa yang 'di ltar yin te/ gsung ngag lam 'bras las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud ces pa'i kun gzhi ngos 'dzin pa na/ rje btsun grags pas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsa ba las/ rgyas bshad thog mar kun gzhi'i rang bzhin dang / /zhes sogs dang de'i 'grel par/ dang po ni sems nyid 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis ka'i rgyur gyur pa/ rigs sam phyogs su ma lhung ba gnas skabs du mar snang ba tsam yin no/ /zhes dang / gzhung bshad sras don ma las/ de yang kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ni sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i rgyur gyur pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang / rje btsun rtse mos rgyud sde spyi rnam las kyang / dang po spyir rgyud ces bya ba ni rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'di kho na la rgyud ces bya ste/ thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du zag bcas kyi sems rgyun mi 'chad pas na rgyud do/ /zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gsum pa'i zur dang po ni/ 'di nyid las/ lang gshegs stug po bkod pa dang / /zhes sogs bshad pas grub cing / zur gnyis pa lang gshegs dang stug po bkod pa dang zla grags sogs kyis bshad pa'i kun gzhi de nyid shes pa yin pa yang 'di ltar yin te/ kun mkhyen chen po 'di nyid kyi 'jug ṭīka las/ zla ba grags pa'i lugs kyi kun gzhi gtan la 'bebs pa la/ kun gzhi'i ngo bo sogs don tshan bdun du bshad pa'i dang po la/ dang po ni/ tshogs drug las ngo bo tha dad pa yod pa ma yin gyi/

rnam par shes pa gsal tsam gyi ngo bo sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du rgyun ma chad par yod pa 'di nyid dge mi dge'i rigs sam/ yul drug gi phyogs su ma chad par rang bzhin gyi stong pas bya byed rung ba'i cha nas kun gzhir 'jog ces/ kun gzhi sems gsal rig gi steng nas 'jog par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags bzhi pa'i zur dang po ni/ 'di nyid las/ zab mo'i rgyud du 'jam dpal dang / /ye shes chen po lhan cig skyes/ /zhes sogs bshad pas grub cing / zur gnyis pa rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i lhan skyes dang ye shes chen po sogs shes pa yin pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ thog med srid pa'i bag chags kyis/ /phyi rol don ni yongs su brtags/ /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /sems ni kun tu 'gro bar brjod/ /ces sogs gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na 'dir bde gshegs snying po la gsal stong zung 'jug gsum du bshad pa 'di nyid/ 'khor 'das dbyer med las/ rang bzhin gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug dang / /nyon mongs rlung dang yi ge rtsa dang khams/ /zhes sogs rgyu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyi shu rtsa bdun bshad pa'i rtsa ba rang bzhin gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dang gnad gcig pas/ sems gsal rig gcig nyid la ldog pa'i sgo nas phye ba tsam du shes pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /des na gzhi bde gshegs snying po gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes kho na la 'chad pa 'di la dpyod ldan gyis dogs pa gnyis spang dgos te/ de yang dogs pa dang po ni/ bde gshegs snying po gsal rig tu 'chad pa/ rje btsun sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa min te/ sdom gsum las/ rig pa yin na rnam shes kyi/ /tshogs brgyad nyid las 'da' ba med/ /tshogs brgyad 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ /bde gshegs snying por mi 'thad de/ /mdo las bde gshegs snying po ni/

/'dus ma byas su gsungs phyir ro/ /zhes rig pa yin na rnam shes tshogs brgyad mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang rung yin pas khyab cing / tshogs brgyad mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa la 'dus byas yin pas khyab pa'i phyir na/ bde gshegs snying por mi 'thad de/ bde gshegs snying po yin na 'dus ma byas yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ 'di la paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can/ spyir shes pa la rnam shes dang / ye shes gnyis yod pa'i rnam shes la/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pas khyab cing de nyid 'dus byas yin pas bde gshegs snying por mi 'thad ces bkag nas/ kun gzhi'i ye shes de nyid 'dus ma byas kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir na rnam shes tshogs brgyad gang rung ma yin pas skyon med ces 'chad kyang / kho bo ni/ bka' bar pa'i dngos bstan dang / rigs tshogs kyi dngos bstan la bde gshegs snying po la shes pa ma yin pas khyab par bshad pas/ sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum du/ de nyid so sor bzhag pa'i dgongs pa bskangs pa yin la/ 'dir ni bka' bar mtha' gnyis dang / klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis dang / mdo dang rgyud sde gnyis sogs kyi dgongs pa 'gal med du bsgrub nas 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas sngar gyi skyon de dag med de/ lugs srol so so yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dogs pa gnyis ni/ bde gshegs snying po gsal rig tu 'chad pa bstan bcos mdzad pa 'di'i dgongs pa min te/ bstan bcos 'di nyid las/ kha cig sems kyi stong gsal gnyis/ /'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas kyi/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs so sor 'dod/ /ces sems kyi gsal cha rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /snyam na skyon med de/ 'dir ni gsal stong zung 'jug gi gsal cha de/ 'dus byas rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa 'gog par mdzad kyi/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa tsam mi 'gog ste/ gsal cha de nyid 'dus ma byas yin par bstan bcos mdzad pa 'di nyid bzhed pa'i phyir te/

gsal cha de nyid bde gshegs snying por gong du sgrub zin cing / bde gshegs snying po la 'dus ma byas kyis khyab pa'i phyir dang / bstan bcos mdzad pa 'dis 'jug pa bka' 'grel las/ 'bras dus kyi rnam mkhyen rtag pa yin par bshad pas/ gzhi dus kyi dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ye shes 'di yang rtag pa yin par bzhed dgos pa'i phyir ro// //gnyis pa log rtog bye brag tu dgag pa la lnga/ med dgag snying por 'dod pa 'gag snying po gnyis su dbye ba dpyad/ 'gro kun snying pos gtong ba dgag dag pa gnyis po 'gal ba dgag snying po bden par sgrub pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir bde gshegs snying po la bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mang du yod de/ snying po de 'bras dus kyi chos sku kho nar ngos gzung nas sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la yod par 'chad pa dang / dri bcas kyi chos dbyings kho na la ngos bzung nas sems can kho na'i rgyud la yod par 'chad pa dang / snying po de la rgyu 'bras bu rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po gsum du phye nas sangs rgyas dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod par 'chad pa dang / gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi chos sku la ngos bzung nas skye 'phags thams cad la yod par 'chad pa dang bzhi las/ lugs gsum pa de la yang / snying po'i ngo bo med dgag du 'dod pa dang / sgrub par 'dod kyang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis su 'byed pa dang lugs gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po de 'gog pa la/ phyogs snga ma ni/ rje 'di nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi dri lan pad+mor bzhad pa las/ dri bcas kyi sems la rigs pas bden pa bkag tsam bde gshegs snying por 'dod pa ni/ dar ṭīka pa dang de'i rjes 'brang gi lugs smra ba po rnams so/ /zhes pa ltar te/ de yang / deng sang tshig tsam smra ba la ngo mtshar 'dzin pa'i mkhas rlom 'ga' zhig chos can/ khyod kyi gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i ngos 'dzin 'di ltar bzhed de/

dri bcas sems la rigs pa yis bden pa bkag tsam gyi med dgag la bde gshegs snying por 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de dgag pa la gnyis/ bden pa bkag tsam gzhan sel yin par bstan/ des na 'khor 'das gzhi ru 'dod pa 'gal bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dri bcas sems la rigs pas bden pa bkag tsam 'di ni chos can/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang bde gshegs snying por ga la 'thad de mi 'thad par thal/ thogs bcas bsal ba la nam mkha' zhes ni btags pa dang / mgo bor 'bigs nus bsal ba la rwa med ces ni btags pa ltar/ rtog pas dgag bya bcad tsam gyi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir na gnas lugs kyang ma yin na ste de'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ des na sems la bden pa bkag pa'i med dgag snying por 'dod pa'i ngan rtogs gi dra ba 'di dor cig ces bya ste/ med dgag 'di la 'khor ba ji ltar tshang ste ma tshang la/ 'di la lam nyid ji ltar sgom du rung ste mi rung zhing 'di la 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung ste mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la byang khang gsar ba 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan gyis/ 'dir ri bo dge ldan pa la dgag sgrub kyi dpyad pa mdzad pa'i dgag lan 'di ltar mdzad de/ dri bcas sems la rigs pa yis/ /spros pa bkag tsam snying por 'dod/ /'di nyid thogs bcas bsal ba la/ /nam mkha' zhes ni btags pa dang / mgo bor 'bigs nus bsal ba la/ /rwa med ces ni btags pa ltar/ /rtog pas dgag bya bcad tsam gyi/ /rten 'brel yin phyir gnas lugs kyang / /min na rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / /bde gshegs snying por ga la 'thad/ /'di la 'khor ba ji ltar tshang / /'di la lam nyid ji ltar sgom/ /'di la 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung / /de skad smra na lan ci yod/ /'khor gsum rgyud mar mi 'byung ngam/ /zhes mtshungs pa mdzad pa ni mkhas pa dges pa'i rnam 'gyur ma yin te/ kho bo cag dri bcas kyi sems la mtha' bzhi'i spros pa bkag pa tsam snying por mi 'dod kyi/

mtha' bzhi'i spros pa bkag pa'i stong nyid dang / dri bcas kyi sems zung du 'jug pa'i zung 'jug la bde gshegs snying por 'dod ces bshad zin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te de ltar 'dod pa la/ sngar gyi stobs mtshungs 'khor gsum du mi 'gyur ram snyam na/ de ltar mtshungs par 'dod pa ni zab mo'i gnad ma rtogs pa ste/ gsal stong zung 'jug 'khor 'das kyi gzhir rung ba dang / bden pa bkag tsam gyi med dgag 'khor 'das kyi gzhir mi rung ba'i khyad par la blo gros rmongs pa'i rnam 'gyur yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na de gnyis la 'khor 'das kyi gzhir rung mi rung gi khyad par ji ltar yod snyam na/ de'i gnad 'di ltar yin te/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi gsal ba las 'dod chags/ stong pa las zhe sdang / zung 'jug las gti mug sogs langs nas 'khor ba'i gzhi byed/ gzhi gsal stong zung 'jug de nyid/ thabs rang don yid byed dang / shes rab gang zag gi bdag med dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab tsam gyis zin pa las dman pa'i myang 'das gnyis kyi gzhi byed/ thabs gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam rnam dag dang / shes rab 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i tshe/ gsal cha las sprul sku/ stong cha las chos sku/ zung 'jug gi cha las longs sku 'byung bas theg pa chen po'i myang 'das kyi gzhi byed pa'i phyir/ gzhan du med dgag tsam 'khor 'das kyi gzhi yin na/ nam mkha' 'khor 'das kyi gzhi yin zhes smra ba dang khyad par cung zad kyang med de/ khyod kyi gzhi med dgag de gsal ba dang zung 'jug ma yin pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos 'byung ba'i yan lag ma tshang ba'i phyir ro// //gnyis pa snying po gnyis su phye ba la dpyad pa la gsum/ ji ltar gsungs tshul bsdus te bshad/ /dgongs gzhi ngos bzung dgongs pa sgrub/ /gzhan du rtog na 'gal bas dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni pad+mo bzhad pa las/ gnyis su phye ba ni rong ṭīka gi dngos bstan yin la zhes sogs bshad pa ltar/

rong ṭīka gi rjes 'brang kha cig sems kyi stong gsal gnyis la/ 'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs su so sor 'dod de/ rong ṭīka dngos bstan las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di yang mkhas pas re zhig brtag par bya ste/ mthar thug zung 'jug sgrub pa'i phyir du/ gnas skabs su 'khyog po srong pa'i tshul gyis drang don yin na 'gal ba med de/ gsal stong 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis zung 'jug tu sgrub pa la/ ya gyal 'dus byas gsal ba dang 'dus ma byas stong pa gnyis ka dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ de las gzhan du nges pa'i don yin na mi 'thad de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dus byas su 'dod pa dngos smra ba'i lugs yin gyis/ dbu ma pa yi lugs la med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems bde gshegs snying por bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ mi 'gal te/ 'dir rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems 'dus byas bde gshegs snying po yin pa bkag pa yin la/ gong du de nyid 'dus ma byas bde gshegs snying por bsgrub zin pa'i phyir ro// //gsum pa 'gro kun snying pos stong pa dgag pa la gnyis/ phyogs snga brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ phyogs snga smra ba pa ni/ pad+ma bzhad pa las/ 'gro ba la med par 'dod pa ni sngar byon pa'i bu ston kha che dang / deng sang dbus gtsang dang mdo khams na yod pa'i mtshan nyid pa kha cig go zhes pa ltar/ bu ston gyi bde gshegs snying po'i mdzes rgyan dang / paṇa shāka pa'i gser thur sogs kyi rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig ste/ bde gshegs snying po bde gshegs la yod kyi 'gro ba'i rgyud la med de/ 'khor 'das kyi chos ni thams cad kyi snying po rang rang kho na la yod pa'i phyir dang / mdo 'ga' zhig las bde gshegs snying po 'gro ba la yod par gsungs pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis sdom gsum dang 'phrin zhu sogs las/

dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed kyi chos gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du gtan la phab pa yin no zhes sgro 'dogs par byed do/ /gnyis pa de dgag pa la gsum/ lung dang rigs pa'i gnod byed bstan/ 'jam dbyangs dgongs par 'dod pa dgag 'khrul med gnad kyi gdams pa sbyin pa'o/ /dang po la bstan/ bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi snying po rang rang kho na la yod ces smra ba 'di ni chos can/ mi 'thad de/ 'jig rten dang bstan bcos kyi tha snyad gnyis las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten tha snyad 'gal bas dgag bstan bcos tha snyad 'gal bas dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyod kyi 'dod pa ni chos can/ bstan bcos pa dang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad dang 'gal te/ tsan+dan 'ga' zhig la sbrul gyi snying po zhes dang / mar ni 'o ma'i snying po zhes dang / tshwa ni chu'i snying po zhes sogs 'jig rten kun la grags pa yi tha snyad kun dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ khyod kyis ni/ sbrul gyi snying po sbrul nyid dang / mar gyi snying po mar nyid dang / chu'i snying po chu kho na la yod ces khas blangs pa'i phyir dang / der ma zad sa bcad gnyis pa ltar/ bstan bcos kyi tha snyad dang yang 'gal te/ dri ma med pa'i bka' snying po'i mdo sogs las/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba kun la khyab ces dang / bstan bcos rgyud bla sogs las lus can sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin no zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te de ltar bstan pa de nyid drang don yin no snyam na/ spyir drang nges la 'jog mtshams mang du yod kyang / brjod bya bden gnyis kyi sgo nas drang nges kyi rnam dbye 'byed pa'i tshe/ drang don kun tha snyad du yang med na ni/ phung po khams dang skye mched sogs kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam gzhag kun chos can/ tha snyad du yang med par 'gyur te/ khyod sogs de dag drang don yin pa'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa 'jam mgon dgongs par mi 'thad pa ni/ 'gro la bde gshegs snying po med pa 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi dgongs par 'dod ces pa la ni/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gsungs dang 'gal ba 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rab dbye las/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas dang / /'khor ba gnyis ka 'byung ba 'thad/ /ces spros bral gyi chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po yin par gsung ba dang / gzhan yang rab dbye de nyid las/ sems ni rang gnas snyegs pa'i phyir/ /me yi sgrub byed tsha ba ltar/ /bde gshegs khams kyi sgrub byed 'thad/ /ces 'khor ba spong 'dod dang / myang 'das thob 'dod kyi blo skyes pa ni/ rang rgyud la bde gshegs snying po yod pa rkyen gyis rigs sad pa'i sgrub byed du gsungs pa dang cis mi 'gal te 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad/ gzhan yang rab dbye las/ gal te bem po'i chos kyi dbyings/ /bde gshegs snying po ma yin yang / /sems can rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings/ /bde gshegs snying po yin snyam na/ /ma yin chos kyi dbyings la ni/ /dbye ba med par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes bem po'i chos dbyings dang / sems can gyi sems kyi chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po yin par khyad par med de/ chos dbyings la rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pas kyang gnod pa yin pa'i phyir te/ sems can gyi sems kyi chos dbyings dang / sangs rgyas kyi sems kyi chos dbyings gnyis snying po yin par khyad par med de/ chos dbyings la rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro zhes pa kun tu mi mtshungs sam ste mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /thal ba 'di ni phyogs snga 'di 'gog pa'i gnod byed kyi gtso bo yin te/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan na re/ sdom gsum rab dbyer chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po yin pa bkag nas/

chos sku bde gshegs snying po yin par bstan pa yin la/ chos dbyings snying po yin pa ji ltar bkag na/ gal te bem po'i chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes sogs kyis bem po'i chos dbyings snying po min pa bzhin du/ sems kyi chos dbyings kyang snying po ma yin te/ chos dbyings la dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ bem po'i chos dbyings snying po ma yin te/ gal te yin na/ brtan g.yo kun bde gshegs snying po can du thal ba la/ g.yo ba lus can kho na bde gshegs snying po can du bshad pa'i phyir ro zhes 'chad mod/ de la 'di ltar 'gal te/ 'o na dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings snying po yin pa bzhin du/ dri bcas kyi chos dbyings kyang snying po yin par thal/ chos dbyings la dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ gal te dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings kyang snying po min no snyam na/ de chos can/ bde gshegs snying po yin par thal/ chos sku yin pa'i phyir gsum kar e dran/ des na 'dir dpyad dgos pa ni/ 'o na khyod rang bem po'i chos dbyings bde gshegs snying por khas len nam mi len/ mi len na 'dir dngos su bshad pa dang 'gal/ len na bem po'i chos dbyings chos can/ gsal stong zung 'jug yin par thal/ chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs so/ /'dod na/ bum sogs phyi don bden pas stong ba'i stong nyid kyang gsal stong zung 'jug tu 'gyur bas khyod rang gi phar phyin dka' 'grel las/ chos dbyings dang stong nyid la khyad phye nas/ chos dbyings la gsal stong zung 'jug gis khyab pa dang / stong nyid sogs la des ma khyab par bshad pa la rnam gcod med pa'i skyon du 'gyur te/ chos thams cad la gsal stong zung 'jug gi chos dbyings kyis khyab pa'i phyir snyam na/ cung zad dka' mod/ kho bo ni kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs pa 'di ltar 'chad de/ spyir stong nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / rang bzhin rnam dag sogs kyis chos thams cad la khyab cing /

de dag la gsal stong zung 'jug yin pa zhig mi dgos kyang / chos dbyings dang bde gshegs snying po sogs gsal stong zung 'jug kho na la 'jog pas/ de dag gis chos thams cad la khyab pas/ bum pa bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid lta bu/ rang bzhin rnam dag dang / stong nyid dang / de bzhin nyid sogs yin kyang / gsal stong zung 'jug ma yin pas/ chos dbyings dang bde gshegs snying po sogs su khas mi len no/ /'on kyang 'dir bem po'i chos dbyings bde gshegs snying por bshad pa ni/ bem po kun la chos dbyings kyis khyab pa dang / bum sogs kun gyi stong nyid bde gshegs snying po yin zhes khas blangs pa ma yin gyi/ nang sems kyi rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i mig sogs lta bu'i steng du gsal stong zung 'jug gi chos dbyings tshang bas/ sems rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i bem po'i chos dbyings snying po yin pa tsam la dgongs so zhes blo gsal dpyod ldan dag gi snying gi pad+mor sim par bya'o/ /des na rang gi ngan rtog khwa ta yis lta ngan mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu chos can/ khyod kyi 'jam dbyangs gzhung bzang pad+ma'i tshal dri zhim ldan pa la/ grub mtha' ngan pa'i dri ngan bsgo ba mtshar che ste/ rang gi skyon gzhan la bgo ba mi rigs pa chen po yin pa'i phyir ro// //gsum pa grub pa'i gdams pa sbyin pa la gsum/ phyogs 'dzin dor nas gzung bar gdams pa/ /drang nges gnad kyi snying po bstan pa/ /don de yid ches lung dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhan gyi 'chad tshul la skyon chags pa des na/ rang bzhin gyi mkhas pa kun chos can/ kho bos 'di ltar 'chad pa la phrag dog dang phyogs 'dzin gyi yid dor la/ gzu bor gnas pa'i blo yis yin min dpyod cig ces bya ste/ bka' bstan bcos kyi gzhung lugs chen po yi dgongs pa kho bos ma 'dres par tshul bzhin bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos dbyings dang bde gshegs snying po dang /

stong nyid dang de bzhin nyid la sogs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bstan pa'i zung 'jug chos can/ brjod bya'i sgo nas drang nges 'byed pa'i tshe nges don yin gyi drang don ma yin te/ don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gsal stong zung 'jug de nyid snying po'i mdo dang rgyud bla las dpe dgus bstan pa ltar/ 'gro ba'i rgyud la ni rten dang brten pa'i tshul gyis sam sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa ni chos can/ drang don yin gyi nges don min te/ kun rdzob bden pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bde gshegs snying po chos can/ khyod 'gro ba'i rgyud la sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa drang don yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan yang yod de/ khyod 'gro ba'i rgyud la yod par ston pa'i mdo'i dgongs gzhi mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi stong nyid yin pa dang / dgos pa skyon lnga spong ba'i phyir du gsungs zhes pa yang khyod 'gro ba'i rgyud la sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod par ston pa'i mdo 'di la 'thad pa'i phyir dang / khyod 'gro ba'i rgyud la sgrub pa'i tshul gyi yod pa de nyid nges pa'i don yin na/ mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs pa dang / bden pa'i dngos por 'gyur ba sogs dngos la gnod byed kyi skyon rnams kyang 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa lung dang sbyar ba ni/ bde gshegs snying po nges don nam bden pa yin yang / de 'gro ba'i rgyud la sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa drang don kun rdzob bden pa yin zhes pa 'di nyid chos can/ kho bos rang bzo ma yin te/ theg chen rgyud bla las/ 'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /rtogs phyir ji lta nyid de dang / /zhes sogs kyis 'gro ba'i sems rgyud bdag gnyis kyi spros pa nyer zhi'i chos nyid mthong ba la ji lta ba mthong bar gsungs pa dang / shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can thams cad la yod par/

/mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid/ /ces spros bral chos nyid de nyid kyang sems can thams cad la yod par mthong ba la ji snyed pa mthong bar ni gsungs pa'i gnad/ rtogs na 'bad med du 'grub pa'i phyir/ 'dir dogs pa 'di ltar bcad dgos te/ 'o na bde gshegs snying po 'gro ba'i rgyud la sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod dam med/ yod na de ltar ston pa'i mdo de/ dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don gyi mdor 'chad mi rigs par thal/ de de ltar yod pa la dngos la gnod byed kyi tshad ma med pa'i phyir te/ de de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ yang bde gshegs snying po nges don yin yang / bde gshegs snying po yod pa de drang don yin zhes khas len rigs par thal/ de de ltar yod pa gang zhig de de ltar yod pa de drang don yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rnam gcod ci yod soms shig gal te de 'gro ba'i rgyud la sgrub pa'i tshul gyis med na/ de de ltar yod par thal/ de de ltar yod pa de tha snyad bden pa yin pa'i phyir dang / de de ltar yod par ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis dngos zhes zer na don dang mthun pa'i lan ci ltar 'debs/ 'di la kho bo re zhig 'di ltar sems te/ snying po ni mdo dang rgyud bla sogs su/ 'gro ba'i rgyud la bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod par bshad la de'i don/ sems tsam pas don dam du 'gro ba'i rgyud la bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod cing / de de ltar yod pa de don dam bden pa dang / de ston pa'i mdo bstan bcos sogs nges don gyi lung du 'grel la/ dbu ma pas ni/ tha snyad tsam du 'gro ba'i rgyud la bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa tsam zhig khas len gyi/ don dam du ma yin pas/ de de ltar yod pa de kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang /

de ston pa'i bka' bstan bcos sogs drang don gyi lung du bshad nas/ don dam du de de ltar yod pa la dngos la gnod byed kyi tshad ma 'chad pa yin no/ /zhes kun mkhyen chen po dgongs par 'chad do// //bzhi pa dag pa gnyis po 'gal bar 'dod pa dgag pa la gnyis/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po la phyogs snga smra ba po ni/ pad+mo bzhad pa las/ de gnyis 'gal bar 'dod pa ni/ deng sang gi mtshan nyid pa phal cher ro/ /zhes pa ltar/ de dus kyi mtshan nyid pa kha cig ste/ glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings ni/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings min te/ sgrub byed rang bzhin rnam dag dang / glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings gnyis phan tshun spangs te gnas pa'i phyir zhes zer ba thos so/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ 'gal bar 'dod pa'i 'dod pas smad/ 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan sgrub byed dgag mi 'gal gnad kyi rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar smra ba'i kha'i bu ga chos can/ bu ga don med gzhan dang mtshungs te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ dri ma bden grub kyis dag pa'i dbyings dang / glo bur gyi dri ma gnyen pos bcom pa'i dbyings kyi gzhi mthun med ces pa'i tshig 'byung ba'i bu ga yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la kho na re/ dag pa gnyis po 'gal te/ chos dbyings la dri ma rang bzhin gyis dag tsam gyi cha dang / dri ma gnyen pos bcom nas gsar du dag pa'i cha gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir snyam na/ 'o na bum pa'i steng du byas pa dang mi rtag pa gnyis 'gal bar 'gyur bar thal/ bum pa skyes tsam gyi cha dang / bum pa 'jig pa ste zhig pa'i cha gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ 'di'i zhib cha de ltar byed dgos te/ gzhan du na phyogs snga phyi gnyis kyi thal ba la rtags ma grub kyi lan thebs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la kho na re/ dag pa gnyis po mi 'gal na/ dag pa dang po rang bzhin rnam dag mngon du gyur pa'i tshe na/ gnyis pa glo bur rnam dag mtha' dag mngon du 'gyur dgos te/

gnyis pa glo bur rnam dag de/ dang po rang bzhin rnam dag yin pa'i phyir snyam na/ tshig gi sgrib g.yogs yin pas snying po med de/ 'o na bdag med dang po gang zag bdag med mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ bdag med gnyis pa chos kyi bdag med mtha' dag mngon du 'gyur dgos te/ bdag med gnyis pa bdag med dang po yin pa'i phyir ro zhes sogs rigs pa kun tu mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mi 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de gnyis 'gal ba la skyon yod pa des na/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings dang / glo bur rnam dag gi chos dbyings gnyis spyi bye brag yin pas mi 'gal te/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/ gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can rnams la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid sbyang ba byas pa la/ /dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /zhes chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag gi steng du/ dri ma gnyen pos sbyangs pas glo bur rnam dag gi chos dbyings de/ myang 'das dang chos skur gsungs pas/ dag pa gnyis kyi gzhi mthun bstan pa'i phyir dang / sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyang / chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin bzhin pa la/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i tshe dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings zhes gsungs pa tshad mar byas nas/ chos dbyings kun rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings yin par shes par gyis shig ste byed dgos pa'i phyir ro// //lnga pa snying po bden sgrub tu 'dod pa dgag pa la gnyis/ phyogs snga brjod pa dang / de la dpyad pa bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sgro skur spangs te smra po gzung / de smra grub mtha'i rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po pad+ma bzhad pa las/ rnam rig bag chags kyis sgrib pa'i skyes chen shes bya kun la bden pa gnyis dang mtshan nyid gsum du phye nas/

kun btags dang gzhan dbang kun rdzob dang / yongs grub don dam bden par byas te/ don dam bden pa'i gcig tu grub par 'dod pa sogs ni jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i nges don rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin par bkod pa yin la zhes pa ltar 'di yi phyogs snga smra ba po 'ga' zhig chos can/ skyon yon gyi cha shas cung zad dang ldan te/ mkhyen rab kyi gshog yangs zung 'brel du rgyas pa yis/ gsung rab kyi nam mkha' la yun ring du bgrod par gyur kyang / rnam rig pa'i bag chags kyi ling tog gis ye shes kyi mig bsgribs pa'i rkyen gyis/ nges don rnam mkha'i nor bu cung zad ma gzigs pa'i skyes chen yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ shes bya gzhi'i gnas tshul bshad/ de las 'bras bu thob tshul bshad/ rang stong gzhan stong khyad par bshad/ gzhi 'bras dbyer med rgyu mtshan bshad/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos dgongs par ldan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ jo nang pas gzhi'i gnas tshul 'di skad gsung ste/ shes bya kun la bden pa gnyis dang mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba las/ kun btags dang gzhan dbang kun rdzob ste bden par ma grub la/ yongs grub don dam bden pa ste bden par grub bo zhes bzhed cing / chos rnams kun gyi don dam chos nyid ni/ sangs rgyas yin par khyad par med pa'i phyir na/ sems can kun gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas nyid yod kyi sems can sangs rgyas ni min no zhes bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ 'bras bu'i thob tshul 'di skad gsung ste/ don dam chos sku rang 'khrungs ni tshogs gnyis bsags pas thob mi dgos par gdod ma nas yod pa la/ kun rdzob tshogs gnyis bsags pa yis/ kun rdzob gzugs sku thob par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rang stong gzhan stong gi khyad par 'di skad gsung ste/ don dam bden pa ni gzhan stong yin gyi/ rang stong ma yin te/ de kun rdzob chos kyis stong gi

rang gi ngo bos mi stong pa'i phyir te/ rtag brtan ther zug bden grub yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kun rdzob ni rang stong yin gyi gzhan stong ma yin te/ rang gi ngo bos stong ba'i phyir zhes bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi don 'di skad gsung ste/ don dam chos nyid 'di ni gzhi dus su glo bur dri mas ma dag pa dang / 'bras bu'i skabs su dri mas dag pa tsam ma gtogs gzhi 'bras skabs kyi chos nyid la yon tan mang nyung dang / bzang ngan ldog pa khyad par med cing / 'di ni bden pa'i gcig tu yang grub pa yin te/ stobs sogs chos sku'i yon tan so gnyis dang / gzugs sku'i yon tan mtshan bzang so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad bcu sogs dam pa'i don du chos nyid 'di la dbyer med du tshang ba'i phyir ro zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ni/ jo nang pa na re/ bshad ma thag pa de dag nges don gyi bka' bstan bcos kun gyi dgongs pa mthar thug yin te/ lha mo dpal phreng mas zhus pa'i mdo/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo/ sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo/ dgongs 'grel la sogs pa lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo/ 'phel 'grib med par bstan pa'i mdo/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa'i mdo ste/ nges don gyi mdo bcu'i dgongs pa 'di nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / byams pa'i gsung rab rnam pa lnga dang / thogs med sku mched kyi sa sde lnga dang sdom rnam pa gnyis dang pra ka ra na sde brgyad dang / phyogs kyi glang po'i brgyad stong don bsdus dang / chos kyi grags pa'i sde bdun sogs gzhung lugs rnams kyang dbu ma chen po'i lugs yin pas/ de dag gi dgongs pa'ang sngar bshad pa 'di nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / klu sgrub yab sras kyang ni 'di nyid bzhed pa'i phyir dang /

zab mo'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig pa yang 'di nyid yin pa'i phyir zhes smra bar byed do/ /gnyis pa dpyad pa bya ba la gsum/ sgro skur spangs pa'i lung rigs dpyad pa dngos/ sgro skur spangs nas dpyad pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ jo nang pa'i grub mtha' 'di chos can/ khyod la sgro skur spangs nas lung dang rigs pas dpyad par bya ste/ khyod mkhas pas dgag sgrub bya ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'dod pa mthun pa blang byar bstan pa/ lhag ma tha snyad don dam 'gal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi 'bras kun tu rang gi ngo bo la bzang ngan gyi dbyer med pa'i chos dbyings de nyid/ bde gshegs snying po yin pa dang / de nyid stobs sogs yon tan rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i don dam pa'i sangs rgyas/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas yin pa ni chos can/ dgag par bya ba min te/ khyod theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin par kho bo yang 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis bstan/ bshad do/ /dang po ni/ lhag ma chos nyid bden par grub cing / de nyid stobs sogs yon tan tshang ba'i sangs rgyas yin par smra ba chos can/ lung dang rigs pas dgag par bya ste/ tha snyad don dam pa gnyis dang 'gal ba 'chad par 'gyur ba 'di ltar mthong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas bshad pa la gnyis/ gzhi 'bras 'dod tshul tha snyad 'gal/ gnas lugs 'dod tshul don dam 'gal ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gzhi'i 'dod tshul tha snyad 'gal/ 'bras bu'i 'dod tshul rigs pas gnod pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ dri bcas sangs rgyas yin pa 'gal bas dgag tha snyad 'gal ba skyon med yin pa dgag tha snyad nyid la'ang snga ma khas len dgag des na mtshan btags phye ba gnad du che ba'o/ /dang po ni/ jo nang pa na re/ khyod kyis tha snyad sgo nas gsung rab kyi don 'chad pa'i tshe/ dri mas ma dag pa'i chos dbyings sangs rgyas yin zhes smra ba ni tha snyad nyid dang 'gal ba yin te/

khyod kyi de ltar na tha snyad tshe na dman mnyam sogs khyad med du 'gyur ba las/ tha snyad tshe na dman mnyam dang khyad 'phags yod med skye dgag sogs so sor phye nas smra dgos pa'i phyir te/ smra dgos pa de skad du yang / klu sgrub kyis stong nyid bdun cu pa las ni/ gnas pa'am skye 'jig yod med dam/ /dman pa'am mnyam dang khyad par can/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten snyad dbang gis/ /gsung gi yang dag dbang gis min/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni kho na re/ tha snyad kyi tshe na dman mnyam sogs so sor smra dgos pa de yin mod/ tha snyad de nyid gsung rab kyi don la dpyod pa'i tshe tshad mar byed na ni/ gang zag la mi rton chos la rton pa dang / tshig la mi rton don la rton pa dang / drang don la mi rton nges don la rton pa dang / rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton pa ste/ rton pa bzhi'i go rim rnams log pa nyid du 'gyur te/ chos la mi rton gang zag la rton pa dang / don la mi rton tshig la rton pa sogs kyi phyir ro zhe na/ rton pa bzhi po de'i go rim 'di ltar yin te/ thog mar tha snyad khas blangs nas phyi nas dam pa'i gnas lugs la rim gyis 'jug pa yin gyi/ tha snyad nyid dang po nas dor na ni/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs su tha snyad gsungs pa don med du 'gyur ba 'am/ rton pa bzhi'i go rim log par khyod la 'gyur te/ de ltar 'gyur ba de skad du yang rtsod zlog las/ tha snyad khas ni ma blangs par/ /nged cag 'chad par ma byed do/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rtsa ba'i shes rab las kyang / tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / zla ba grags pas kyang / kun rdzob dang don dam thabs dang thabs byung yin pa'i phyir na de gnyis kyi rnam dbye mi shes pa de/ lam ngan pa la zhugs par gsungs pa'ang /

don dam rtogs pa'i thabs su tha snyad yal bar dor ba 'di nyid la dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni gal te kho na re/ tha snyad yal bar dor ba'i skyon med de/ tha snyad kyi tshe na yang dri mas ma dag pa'i chos dbyings nyid sangs rgyas su smra ba yin pas so snyam na/ dri mas ma dag pa'i chos dbyings sangs rgyas su smra ba 'di ni chos can/ 'phags pa byams pa dang klu sgrub sogs kyi gzhung dang 'gal ba yin te/ ci'i slad du zhe na rgyud bla mar/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes chos dbyings la gnas skabs gsum du ming gsum so sor gsungs pa dang / klu sgrub kyi chos dbyings bstod pa las/ ji ltar sos ka'i dus su chu/ /dro 'o zhes ni brjod par byed/ /de nyid grang ba'i dus su ni/ /grang ngo zhes ni brjod pa bzhin/ /nyon mongs drwa bas g.yogs pa na/ /sems can zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /de nyid nyon mongs bral gyur na/ /sangs rgyas shes ni brjod par byed/ /ces gsung pa dang / gzhan chos dbyings bstod pa de nyid las/ ji ltar sbun pas g.yogs pa na/ /so ba 'bras bur mi 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pas/ /de ni sangs rgyas zhes mi btags/ /ji ltar sbun pa las grol na/ /'bras nyid snang bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs bral gyur na/ /chos kyi sku yang rab tu gsal/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang mdo sde rgyan la/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ /khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes sogs kyis chos dbyings dri mas ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su sems can dang / dag pa'i gnas skabs su sangs rgyas kyi tha snyad so sor gsungs kyi/ ma dag pa'i chos dbyings sangs rgyas su ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa mtshan btags phye ba la'ang /

mtshan btags phye ba dpe dang bcas te bstan/ /don la mtshan brtags mi 'byed lung rigs gnyis dang 'gal/ /dpe la mtshan brtags mi phyed rgya bod gzhung dang 'gal/ /des na 'khrul med gnad don blang byar bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gal te kho na re/ rgyud las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib/ /zhes sogs lta bu/ rgyu dus su yang / ma dag pa'i chos dbyings sangs rgyas su bshad pa mang du yod do snyam na/ de ni dngos btags ma phyed pa'i skyon yin te/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pa ni/ ma dag pa'i chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas tsam yin zhes pa ste/ sangs rgyas brtags pa ba yin la/ de bsal nas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /zhes pa ni/ dri mas dag pa'i chos dbyings de/ glo bur rnam dag gi sangs rgyas yin zhes pa ste sangs rgyas mtshan nyid par 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/ dpal ldan rtse mo yi rgyud sde spyi rnam las kyai rdo rje zhes bya ba'i mtshan gyis ni/ 'bras rgyud kyai rdo rje dngos su bstan nas/ rgyu rgyud dang / lam thabs rgyud gnyis kyi kyai rdo rje shugs las shes pa'i mthun pa'i dper/ phyogs kyi glang pos/ brgyad stong don bsdus las/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub bya de don sbyor ba yi/ /gzhung lam dag la de sgra yin/ /zhes sher phyin dngos ni/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes te/ gzhung dang lam gyi sher phyin gnyis btags pa bar bkod pa 'di gus pas long zhig ces bya ste/ dngos btags phye dgos pa des na/ 'bras bu sher phyin sher phyin dngos dang / gzhung lam gyi sher phyin sher phyin btags pa bar bshad pa de bzhin du/ 'bras bu kyai rdo rje kyai rdo rje mtshan nyid pa dang / rgyu lam gyi kyai rdo rje de kyai rdo rje btags pa ba yin pa dang / glo bur rnam dag gi sangs rgyas sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa dang /

rang bzhin rnam dag tsam gyi sangs rgyas sangs rgyas btags pa ba yin pa sogs/ ming mtshungs pa rnams la dngos btags kyi khyad par 'khrul med du phyed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ pad+ma bzhad pa las/ zhar byung rgyud gsum ka kyai rdor mtshan nyid par 'dod pa ni sngar byon pa'i kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang / phyis kyi rang lugs kyi bla ma kha cig go /zhes pa ltar/ gal te rdzongs pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs kha cig na re/ rgyud gsum gyi kyai rdor la dngos brtags phye ba mi 'thad par thal/ jo nang par ma zad/ rtse mo'i spyi rnam lugs 'di la yang kyai rdor rgyud gsum ka kyai rdor mtshan nyid par bzhed pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de ltar mi 'thad de/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi mtshan don 'chad pa'i tshe/ mtshon bya don gyi kyai rdo rje zhes pa'i sgra/ rgyu rgyud rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems dang / thabs rgyud dbang lam gyi ye shes dang / 'bras rgyud dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes te rgyud ni gsum char la 'jug kyang / de nyid la dngos brtags phye ba'i tshe/ sangs rgyas sa'i ye shes la/ brtag gnyis las/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra shes rab brjod par bya/ /zhes bya ba'i he'i don/ dmigs med kyi thugs rje chen po dang / badz+ra rdo rje'i don/ gnas lugs rtogs pa mthar phyin shes rab chen po zung 'jug tshang ba yin pas na brjod bya don gyi kyai rdo rje dngos yin la/ rgyu rgyud rang bzhin 'od gsal la'ang / thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /ces pa'i don/ thabs gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba dang / shes rab gdod ma nas spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i gnyis med ye shes zung 'jug tshang ba dang / lam thabs rgyud dbang lam sogs la'ang / thabs bum dbang dang shes rab gong ma gsum ste thabs shes zung 'jug gam/ thabs bskyed rim dang / shes rab rdzogs rim ste thabs shes zung 'jug tsam zhig ni tshang bas nas/

kyai rdo rje'i sgra brtags ming du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir ro ste/ spyi rnam las/ de bas na sangs rgyas rnams kyi dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / shes rab chen po zung du 'jug pas na kyai rdo rje 'bras bu'i rgyud/ de lta bu'i 'bras bu thob par byed pa'i lam yang kyai rdo rje/ rgyu yang kyai rdo rje yin dgos pas rgyud gsum ka kyai rdo rje ste/ phyogs kyi glang pos/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub par byed don sbyor ba yi/ /gzhung dang lam la'ang de sgra yin/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/ /zhes sogs bshad pas so/ /des na dngos brtags ma phye bar rgyu lam 'bras bu'i kyai rdo rje gsum brjod byar mtshon pa las/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud 'chad ces gsungs pa yi don de ltar yin gyi/ gzhan du rgyud gsum ka kyai rdo rjer mtshan nyid pa yin na/ rtse mos/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud ces pa'i tshig zur gyi kyai rdo rje'i sgras 'bras rgyud kyi kyai rdo rje dngos su bstan nas/ rgyu dang lam gyi kyai rdo rje shugs la bstan par bshad pa de mi 'thad dgos te/ de gsum ka kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ bum pa zhes pa'i sgras gser bum dngos su bstan nas dngul bum shugs las bstan pa mi 'thad pa bzhin no/ /de ltar rtse mos gong du bshad na/ spyi rnam las/ de la rgyud kyi mtshan phal cher yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi 'bras bu'i rgyud las brtsams te brtags nas/ de nas thabs rgyud dang rgyu rgyud la shugs la sbyar ba'i mtshan mang ste/ dper na dpal kyai rdo rje dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / yang dag par sbyor ba legs pa lta bu'o/ /zhes bshad pas shes so/ /gsum pa la'ang gsum ste/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung dang 'gal/ rang gi bod gzhung nyid dang 'gal/ de'i dgongs pa dpyad du yod pa'o/

/dang po ni/ ming la rnam grangs du ma yod pa des na ha ri bha dra yis dngos ming dang brtags ming gnyis su gsungs pa dang / dkon mchog 'bangs kyis ming gtso phal gnyis su gsungs pa de gnyis don gcig ste/ dngos brtags gtso phal don gcig pa gzhung lugs chen po'i lugs yin pa'i phyir te/ de skad du yang rnam 'grel las/ ji ltar grags pas grub gang yin/ /dngos dang de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /gang la de skad brjod phal pa/ /dngos la dngos med brtags phyir ro/ /zhes sogs du ma gsungs pa la ltos shig ste/ bltas pas ming gi rnam dbye shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan yang rgyu lam gyi kyai rdor kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa yin pa dpal sa skya pa'i dgongs pa min par ma zad/ gzhung lam gyi shes phyin sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin pa nges don rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ nges don rgya mtshos der ni/ gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes sher phyin mtshan nyid par byas nas/ gzhung lam gyi sher phyin gnyis la sher phyin btags pa bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'on kyang gzhi dus kyi ye shes sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin pa 'di yang mi 'thad de/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi gzhi dus kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin na/ ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu ni dngos yin la/ zhes pas sher phyin gyi rten gyi khyad par bstan pa don med yin pa'i phyir te/ de bzhin gshegs pa min pa'i rgyud la'ang sher phyin yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te skyon med de/ de nyid rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir snyam na/ mi 'thad de/ gzhi dus su de bzhin gshegs pa yod pa la tha snyad dang 'gal ba'i skyon sngar bstan zin la/ skyon gzhan yang gzhung dang lam gnyis la mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba yi gzhung lam gyi yongs grub sher phyin ma yin na/

rang gi grub mtha' chos thams cad la mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba'i yongs grub rnams sher phyin mtshan nyid par khas blangs pa dang 'gal la/ yin na phyogs glang gi gzhung 'di'i don bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ gzhung 'di'i don/ gzhung lam gyi sher phyin sher phyin mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa la khyed kyis kyang bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhan gyi 'chad tshul mi 'thad pa des na/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ces sogs kyi gzhung 'di'i don/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma yis/ gzhung lam sher phyin brtags pa ba dang / 'bras bu sher phyin sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin no zhes bshad pa chos can/ blo ldan rnams kyis gus pas long zhig ces bya ste/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub kun dang mthun pa'i bshad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i 'dod tshul dgag pa ni/ gzhan yang / chos sku glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i cha/ tshogs gnyis la ltos sam mi ltos/ dang po ltar na de chos can/ khyod don dam rang 'khrungs kyi chos sku min par 'gyur la/ khyod nges par tshogs gnyis bsags pas thob dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ltar na 'gro kun gyi rgyud kyi chos nyid chos can/ khyod dang po nyid nas glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral bar 'gyur bar thal/ khyod glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba de/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa la ma ltos par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ 'gro kun gyi rgyud kyi snying po chos can/ khyod dri mas bsgrib pa'i tshul dpe dgus bstan pa don med du 'gyur bar thal/ khyod dang po nas dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir/ 'di la jo nang pa/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang / dri med kyi de bzhin nyid don gcig ces smra ba ni/ mkhas pa'i gtam ma yin te/ 'o na bde gshegs snying po de/ dri mas bsgribs pa dang ma bsgribs pa'i gzhi mthun yin par thal/ dri bcas kyi bde gshegs snying po de/ dri med kyi bde gshegs snying po yin pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang / chu snyog ma can de/ snyog med kyi chur thal ba dang / sprin bcas kyi nam mkha' sprin med kyi nam mkhar thal/ dri bcas kyi chos sku dri med kyi chos sku yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gnas lugs kyi 'dod tshul dgag pa la bzhi/ nges don yid ches lung dang 'gal/ dngos smra 'gog pa'i rigs pa 'gal/ chos 'khor snga phyi'i 'phros dang 'gal/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos dgongs par 'gal ba'o/ /dang po ni khyod kyi don dam gyi 'jog tshul gnas lugs dang 'gal ba 'di ltar mthong ste/ ji ltar snyam na/ chos kyi dbyings yongs grub bden par grub pa ni/ nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde dang / klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ma yin te/ mdo las/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /zhes sogs kyis zab zhi spros bral dang / 'od gsal 'dus ma byas dang lnga/ yongs grub bam chos dbyings kyi ming gi rnam grangs nyid du gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gsungs pa de nyid la/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ skye dang 'jig dang gnas pa dag /ma grub pas na 'dus byas med/ /'dus byas rab tu ma grub pas/ /'dus ma byas ni ga la grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i lung gis skabs 'di'i 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis bden par med par mtshungs pa nyid du ston pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis/ rtsod zlog las/ dngos smra ba'i rtsod pa bdun 'gog pa'i rigs pa rnams dbu ma pa rang la log pa nyid du 'gyur te/ bden grub kyi chos ni yod par dam bcas pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bden grub khas blangs na/ dngos smra bkag pa'i rtsod pa rang la log pa de skad du yang / rtsod zlog las/ gal te ngas dam bcas 'ga' yod/ /des na nga la skyon 'di yod/ /nga la dam bcas med pas na/ /nga ni skyon med kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skabs kyi dam bcas pa'i don/ bden grub kyi chos dam bcas pa nyid la ni/ jo nang pa rang nyid kyang ni 'chad pa'i phyir ro/
